title: Seaborn Package Reference
name: seaborn
description: Seaborn is a Python visualization library based on Matplotlib that provides a high-level interface for drawing attractive and informative statistical graphics.
summary: Statistical data visualization library for Python built on Matplotlib, with high-level APIs for relational, distribution, categorical, regression, matrix, and faceted plots.

import seaborn as sns
